visual_thesis: Prediction loss compares next-token predictions against held-out text; a shared safety pace signal remains a proposal with explicit measurement limits.
mechanism_metaphor: A single enlarged translucent specimen plate exposes a sequence of abstract square token cells. A withheld last cell sits opposite a predicted cell; an open comparison aperture between them represents the measured prediction discrepancy without a numeric scale. A folded sheet behind the sequence stands for the private evaluation distribution. At right an open, visibly uncompleted boundary frame represents a proposed shared limit, not a deployed safety control. Below it two separate cutaway swatches identify what prediction loss does not measure. The unknown floor stays detached. No plotted curves, fake data or precision ticks. Do not imply lower loss guarantees safety.

These are one cohesive composition, never a panel collage. Preserve open background and a strong readable focal relationship at 320px.
